tolerance: Rule statuses and booleans exact. Where the sources only establish that an item must stay open, the check is the boolean '<topic>_open' (any of finding / review required / insufficient data passes; 'no finding' or 'not applicable' fails), because the sources prescribe the obligation, not the tool's grading word. Threshold comparisons follow the literal source wording ('at least', 'no more than', 'less than', 'bis', 'greater than') and boundary cases sit 0.01 m / 0.01 H:V beside the limit, above the display resolution of cm inputs. Slope angle abs 0.01 deg: the display resolution of a degree value shown to two decimals; the arithmetic itself is exact to 1e-12. Cases marked DISPUTABLE in their derivation are to be recorded as flagged, not as failures, if the tool disagrees.
